title: Keep inside a box
prompt: Return the robot's position pushed back inside a box from (0, 0) to (width, height). Each part is clamped separately. (-3, 12) in a 10 by 10 box becomes (0, 10).
starter:
func keep_inside_box(position, width, height) -> Vector2:
	return position
hints: clamp() on x and clamp() on y.

docs.name: clamp(value, low, high)
docs.what: Returns value, but never lower than low or higher than high.

docs.name: Vector2(x, y)
docs.what: Makes a vector holding an x and a y. Read them back with .x and .y.

solution:
func keep_inside_box(position, width, height) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(clamp(position.x, 0, width), clamp(position.y, 0, height))
